name: drive_comments_list
description: Lists a file's comments. For more information, see [Manage comments and replies](https://developers.google.com/workspace/drive/api/guides/manage-comments). Required: The `fields` parameter must be set. To return the exact fields you need, see [Return specific fields](https://developers.google.com/workspace/drive/api/guides/fields-parameter).

pageToken.description: The token for continuing a previous list request on the next page. This should be set to the value of 'nextPageToken' from the previous response.

pageSize.description: The maximum number of comments to return. The service may return fewer than this value. If unspecified, at most 20 comments will be returned. The maximum value is 100; values above 100 will be coerced to 100. (format: int32)

startModifiedTime.description: The minimum value of 'modifiedTime' for the result comments (RFC 3339 date-time).

includeDeleted.description: Whether to include deleted comments. Deleted comments will not include their original content.
